segments.name: Valencia
segments.description: Develops and sells residential and commercial land sites in the Valencia mixed-use planned community to homebuilders and commercial buyers, plus agricultural operations.
segments.evidence: Our Valencia segment includes operating results related to the Valencia community and agricultural operations in Los Angeles and Ventura Counties, California.

segments.name: San Francisco
products: research and development and office space
segments.description: Develops and sells land sites within the Candlestick and The San Francisco Shipyard bayfront communities to homebuilders and commercial developers.
segments.evidence: Our San Francisco segment includes operating results for the Candlestick and The San Francisco Shipyard communities.

segments.name: Great Park
segments.description: Sells land sites at Great Park Neighborhoods and provides development management services to the venture that owns the community.
segments.evidence: Our Great Park segment includes operating results for the Great Park Neighborhoods community as well as development management services provided by the management company for the Great Park Venture.

segments.name: Hearthstone
segments.description: Residential asset management platform providing capital and management services to land banking funds that acquire and develop residential lot option programs.
segments.evidence: We have organized our operations into four reportable segments, three of which are tied to our communities (our Valencia, San Francisco and Great Park segments) and the remaining reportable segment consists of our Hearthstone residential asset management platform.

revenueModel.text: Homebuilders, commercial developers and commercial buyers pay for residential and commercial land sites; the company also earns fees for development management and asset management services.
revenueModel.evidence: We are primarily engaged in the business of planning and developing our three mixed-use planned communities, and our revenues are principally generated by (i) selling residential and commercial land sites to homebuilders, commercial developers and commercial buyers, (ii) providing development management services and (iii) providing asset management services to land banking funds that are primarily focused on acquiring, developing and managing residential lot option programs.

changes.text: In 2024 the company sold the Gateway Commercial Venture's commercial operating assets, and its commercial segment is no longer operating.
changes.evidence: After the sale of the Gateway Commercial Venture's commercial operating assets in December 2024, our commercial segment is no longer operating.

changes.text: In 2025 the company acquired a controlling interest in HRH, adding the new Hearthstone segment.
changes.evidence: In July 2025, the operating company, through its wholly owned subsidiary, acquired 75% of the Class A units of HRH.
